name: nocobase-dev
description: NocoBase V2 dev plugin for Agents Store. Full customization + data management reference covering the nc-mcp MCP server (~146 tools: flow-surfaces, collections, resources, workflows, RBAC, data sources), the HTTP API, and the nocobase-ctl CLI. Includes data-modeling playbook, ui-builder blueprints, ACL governance, publish management, and official upstream skill content.
